title:
Q4 Roadmap Launch Readiness 
Engineering Sync
summary: Internal sync to validate Q4 launch readiness checklist: release gating, SLOs, incident playbooks, rollout cadence, prioritization of low-latency improvements and quantization tests. Agreed next steps around canary plan and two benchmark runs for dedicated vs hosted profiles.
action_items: Daniel Kim: finalize canary rollout plan and share runbook (due: 2026-08-12)
Priya Shah: run dedicated vs hosted perf benchmarks with 8k seq and 2k seq profiles (due: 2026-08-10)
Elena Novak: add two regression prompt sets to QA harness and validate on latest quantized build (due: 2026-08-14)
Marco Alvarez: update release calendar and confirm blackout windows with Sales (due: 2026-08-09)
Aisha Patel: circulate final launch criteria doc + stakeholder signoff list (due: 2026-08-11)
next_steps: Daniel to post canary runbook in #release-playbooks and ping PMs
Priya to upload benchmark results CSV and raw logs to shared drive
Schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to review benchmark outcomes
Security to confirm audit log retention and KMS key rotation schedule (Aisha to loop in security)
transcript:
Header:
Date: 2026-08-05
Start: 10:00 AM PT
Duration: ~75 minutes
Attendees: Aisha, Daniel, Priya, Marco, Elena, Omar (brief)
---
Summary: quick run through of launch readiness items, perf gating, incident response updates

00:00 Aisha: ok folks, thanks for joining, let's kick off. we have the launch checklist up, i sent the deck earlier, slides link in chat, um, goal today is to get final owners and dates.
00:27 Daniel: yep, visibility on eng blockers; last week we had the kv cache regressions on the 2.1 branch, I put a note in jira but i want to align on whether we backpatch or ship with mitigation.
00:45 Priya: hmm the KV cash—sorry—KV cache, yeah, the main problem is cache eviction under load, it causes tail latency spikes. i ran a hotfix in staging but want thorough perf runs before we ship.
01:05 Aisha: right, so action item: priya to run dedicated vs hosted perf benchmarks with the new eviction policy, we need two runs, 8k and 2k seq profiles. can you get that by monday?
01:20 Priya: yeah i'll schedule, probable results by monday afternoon, i'll upload raw logs to the bench sheet.
01:38 Marco: for release windows, sales asked for no more than two blackouts between aug 25 and sep 5, can we commit?
01:52 Daniel: we can if the canary is short, i propose a 48 hour canary in dedicated with automatic rollback threshold at 2.5x error-rate or 20% latency regression.
02:08 Elena: QA needs the regression prompt sets; i put two candidate sets in the QA repo but need signoff on which to use for gating. also need snapshot of quantized model.
02:30 Aisha: noted, elena will add two prompt sets, daniel will finalize canary thresholds and rollbacks, marco will lock blackout windows.
02:45 Omar: quick infra note, key rotation and KMS timeline is on track, but if we change key ids we need an ops window.
03:05 Aisha: good, security concerns: audit log retention — we need to confirm 7 year vs 1 year for certain enterprise customers, but for this launch default set to 1 year. i'll loop in sec.
03:25 Daniel: on the perf side, also want to discuss quantization profile recommendations; if we push an int8 QAT profile, latency looks good but some hallucination increases in auto evals. is that acceptable?
03:50 Priya: that's the tradeoff, cost vs quality; we can roll out quantized variant as an optional route behind a feature flag and default to fp16 on hosted.
04:12 Aisha: ok make that a plan: feature-flag quantized variants, enable behind opt-in for pilot customers. log the eval delta and trigger regression alert if eval drops > 3% on critical prompt set.
04:35 Daniel: question on routing: will we route by latency SLO or cost for the pilot? current smart-routing supports policy by latency, but cost routing needs extra metrics.
04:50 Marco: for launch, let's do latency-first route, with fallback to cheaper variant if dedicated capacity is saturated. we should doc the fallback policy.
05:10 Elena: also, QA will need a stable model artifact, which means we need model pinning in the deployment manifest; can we pin version and checksum in the canary?
05:27 Daniel: yes, manifest will include model-tag and sha256 in the release payload.
05:40 Aisha: perfect. moving on to incident playbooks — we had a postmortem last month about degraded throughput during a rollout, we need to update the step where ops should scale batch size before scaling GPUs because it exacerbated token queueing.
06:05 Priya: i can update the runbook and add a checklist: scale batch, check queue latency, then scale nodes. also add a short roll-back checklist.
06:25 Marco: let's add a new runbook entry for canary rollback procedure with exact kubectl / rollout commands and the monitoring query to determine health.
06:45 Aisha: yep include Grafana links and the specific alerts. who owns that?
06:52 Priya: i'll own the grafana dashboard updates.
07:10 Daniel: back to perf: we should run two benchmark flavors — long-seq 8k to stress kv cache and short-seq 2k typical chat. Priya will run both on dedicated and hosted. also include the newest kernel selection changes in runtime 3.4.
07:32 Elena: QA will run regression harness on both benchmarks, but we need a reproducible seed and tokenization config noted.
07:48 Priya: noted, will include seed and tokenizer config in bench metadata.
08:02 Daniel: there's also a pending PR that changes compilation kernel selection; it improved p99 by 12% in dev but introduced slight throughput variance on multi-tenant. we need to test under a realistic workload.
08:25 Aisha: test under mixed request patterns, yes. who's going to coordinate that?
08:32 Marco: i can coordinate with infra to stitch a multi-tenant tape based on real logs.
08:45 Daniel: will add it to the bench plan.
09:00 Aisha: timeline check — our tentative GA target is 2026-09-15, that leaves us six weeks; we need all blockers cleared by 2026-08-20 to allow for final stabilization. that's the hard freeze date.
09:22 Elena: QA can do a final pass between 8/21 and 9/6, we need stable artifacts by 8/20.
09:30 Aisha: ok freeze 8/20. any objections? anyone foresee major blocker?
09:45 Daniel: the only risk i see is the kv cache regression which if it persists will push us. but with the eviction policy fix and bench runs we should be OK.
10:05 Priya: agreed.
10:20 Aisha: great. quick misc items — pricing and perf tradeoffs: we should prepare a short doc explaining cost per token delta for quantized vs fp16 and for dedicated vs hosted after batching changes. can someone own that?
10:35 Marco: i'll take it with finance, will produce a short spreadsheet.
10:50 Aisha: ownership recap: daniel finalize canary runbook; priya run perf bench and update grafana; elena update QA harness and add prompt sets; marco update release calendar + pricing sheet; aisha circulate launch criteria and loop security.
11:12 Daniel: one more note — make sure to include SLOs in rollout criteria: p95 latency < 150ms for chat median loads, error rate < 0.5%.
11:30 Aisha: add SLOs to launch doc.
11:45 Priya: i'll also verify autoscaler settings to make sure burst capacity behaves during canary.
12:05 Aisha: ok thanking everyone, follow-up meeting: check benchmarks next tuesday 30-min, i'll send invite. meeting adjourned.
---
Notes about transcript quality: some words mis-transcribed (KV cash, K-V cash), occasional speaker overlap, filler words present, punctuation inconsistent.
References/links: slides and benchmark template attached in attachments list above.
Recap (end): owners and due dates reiterated, hard freeze 2026-08-20, GA target 2026-09-15, two benchmark runs required, canary plan with rollback thresholds, quantized variants behind feature flag.
